connected_criminal_course_20260925.scope: Connected, evolving alleged criminal conduct with civil, mercantile, Community, regulatory and recovery dimensions; those instruments may be alleged means, not reasons to fragment or downgrade the allegation.

chronology.actors: Montelanza/Molina dissident owners, relevant companies and representatives, individually identified through the source record
chronology.allegation: Breaches and interference with unified hotel operation, LPB investment and income; subsequent Community-governance capture, exclusion, debt/vote manipulation and operating interference develop that originating conflict.
chronology.boundary: Not a claim that CAM originated the 2008 events or that every dissident/company/representative committed every act. A sale commitment is not proof of completed title transfer.

chronology.period: From the outset of Francisco de Borja Rodríguez-Batllori Laffitte's involvement in Concurso 36/2012
chronology.allegation: Affirmative alignment with dissident interests and representatives from inception, through acts and omissions, rather than merely later negligent supervision; alleged adoption of adverse premises, failure to protect or pursue rights, frustration of funded solutions, use of Community machinery and later facilitation or preservation of CAM advantages.
chronology.boundary: 2016 warnings are knowledge and subsequent-conduct evidence, not the alleged starting point. The earliest acts, appointment/acceptance record, contemporaneous knowledge, duties and contrary protective acts require their own sources.

chronology.allegation: CAM/Acosta Matos allegedly joined, used and strengthened an existing adverse structure through credit acquisition, dealings with dissidents/representatives, particular-unit acquisitions and preparations for material control.
chronology.boundary: Different actors have different entry dates and roles. FMMM and Cogolludo source dates must not be reset to CAM's later entry.

chronology.period: At least by the failure of the convenio and opening of liquidación
chronology.actor: Alberto López Villarrubia, then Magistrate-Judge of Commercial Court No. 1 of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria
chronology.allegation: Judicial acts and treatment of evidence allegedly became part of the mechanism frustrating protective/restorative outcomes and enabling or preserving the adverse private outcome, not only during later 2018–2022 disputes.
chronology.boundary: Do not invent the transition date or say that no convenio was presented. A filed convenio is already controlled at 27-Apr-2017; the certified Junta/evaluation and transition acts remain separately required. Adverse actor describes the alleged substantive role, not an opposing-litigant status. Preserve corrective and favourable judicial acts.

chronology.allegation: Principal alleged material-control and funded-exit sabotage/interruption pivot within the longer course of conduct.
chronology.boundary: Not the origin of the entire alleged mechanism, and not proof of every person's physical presence or instruction.

chronology.allegation: Dissident and CAM interests allegedly continued together through later maintenance, defence, exploitation and consolidation: exclusion from rights/property/governance, physical incorporation, operation and retained income, use of disputed title/authority and resistance to accounting, restoration and recovery.
chronology.boundary: Preserve alleged ongoing acts and benefits separately from accrued or lingering injury. The classification of each offence as continuing, repeated or completed and each remedy's time limits is a separate legal inquiry. No perpetual self-updating factual verification is implied.

private_actor_population.rule: Retain the five principal cards plus separate AC and judge presentations; make the originating dissidents, companies and representatives discoverable through the existing records. The seven-person homepage presentation is not a closed actor census.

two_origins.rule: The protective-insolvency-origin control complements the earlier course-of-conduct origin; it must not reset the whole case to 2012.
